commandDescription.en-US: Sends a message or edits this message in this channel
commandDescription.fr: Envoie un message ou modifie ce message dans ce salon
commandDescription.pt-BR: Envia uma mensagem ou edita esta mensagem neste canal

postSubCommandDescription.en-US: Sends a message in this channel
postSubCommandDescription.fr: Envoie un message dans ce salon

patchSubCommandDescription.en-US: Rewrites the content of this message in this channel
patchSubCommandDescription.fr: Réécrit le contenu de ce message dans ce salon
patchSubCommandDescription.pt-BR: Reescreve o conteúdo desta mensagem neste canal

attachSubCommandDescription.en-US: Adds at a position attachments to this message in this channel
attachSubCommandDescription.fr: Ajoute à une position des pièces jointes à ce message dans ce salon
attachSubCommandDescription.pt-BR: Adiciona em uma posição anexos a esta mensagem neste canal

detachSubCommandDescription.en-US: Removes attachments from this message in this channel
detachSubCommandDescription.fr: Retire des pièces jointes de ce message dans ce salon
detachSubCommandDescription.pt-BR: Remove anexos desta mensagem neste canal

help.en-US:
Type $<postSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription>` to send a message in `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Type $<patchSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` to rewrite the content of `$<messageOptionDescription>` in `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Type $<attachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` to add at a position attachments to `$<messageOptionDescription>` in `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Type $<detachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` to remove attachments of `$<messageOptionDescription>` in `$<channelOptionDescription>`
help.fr:
Tape $<postSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription>` pour envoyer un message dans `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Tape $<patchSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pour réécrire le contenu d'`$<messageOptionDescription>` dans `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Tape $<attachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pour ajouter à une position des pièces jointes à `$<messageOptionDescription>` dans `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Tape $<detachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pour retirer des pièces jointes d'`$<messageOptionDescription>` dans `$<channelOptionDescription>`
help.pt-BR:
Digite $<postSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription>` pra enviar uma mensagem em `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Digite $<patchSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pra reescrever o conteúdo de `$<messageOptionDescription>` em `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Digite $<attachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pra adicionar em uma posição anexos a `$<messageOptionDescription>` em `$<channelOptionDescription>`
Digite $<detachSubCommandMention> `$<channelOptionDescription> $<messageOptionDescription>` pra remover annexos de `$<messageOptionDescription>` em `$<channelOptionDescription>`

noChannelReply.en-US: I do not know any channel with this tag.
noChannelReply.fr: Je ne connais aucun salon avec cette étiquette.
noChannelReply.pt-BR: Não conheço nenhum canal com essa marcação.

noMessageReply.en-US: I do not know any message with this identifier in this channel.
noMessageReply.fr: Je ne connais aucun message avec cet identifiant dans ce salon.
noMessageReply.pt-BR: Não sei nenhuma mensagem com essa identificação neste canal.

noContentOrAttachmentReply.en-US: Please provide a content or attachments.
noContentOrAttachmentReply.fr: Merci de fournir un contenu ou des pièces jointes.
noContentOrAttachmentReply.pt-BR: Por favor, forneça um conteúdo ou anexos.

noPermissionReply.en-US: I do not have the rights to send this message.
noPermissionReply.fr: Je n'ai pas les droits pour envoyer ce message.
noPermissionReply.pt-BR: Eu não tenho as permissões pra enviar essa mensagem.
